title: Cacao & Clay Ofrenda Circle (September)
source_quote: Cacao & Clay Ofrenda Circle | Sunday, 20 September | 18:00 - 20:30 | Celebrate the change of seasons and Latinx Heritage Month with a Cacao and Clay Ofrenda Gifts Circle.
evidence_sentence: The event description mentions hands-on clay sculpting but does not describe a firing; it is a sculpting and community ritual session.
evidence_quote: This gathering focuses on noticing the language of the earth through sculpting from the heart and community connection.
